lines.speaker: charlie
lines.text: Red planet, courier on approach. Is anyone receiving?

lines.speaker: quiet_choir
lines.text: We receive everything, traveller. Every signal. Every whisper. Every thought you think you kept to yourself.

lines.speaker: quiet_choir
lines.text: This is the Quiet Choir. We sing to what sleeps beneath the rock, so that it may keep sleeping. Mostly.

lines.speaker: quiet_choir
lines.text: There is a shrine on the surface. Look, if you must. Do not touch the offerings. We cannot stress this enough.

lines.speaker: quiet_choir
lines.text: Some of our brothers and sisters travel to the grey world. If they ask for passage, be kind. Be very kind.

lines.speaker: quiet_choir
lines.text: Oh, that. The hymn is always playing. You will stop noticing it in a few days. Or you will start singing along.

lines.speaker: quiet_choir
lines.text: Land if you wish, traveller. The Choir is patient. The thing beneath the rock is less so.

options.line: Are there more of you out there?
What is that humming on the channel?
